notes.title: Farmer's Dynasty - Your Farm Wants You!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778107/350ef508d6ec6d80dc316af7058f84011c305d2a.jpg

Hello dear Farmers!

We know it has been a while since you heard from us.

And we know, you are eagerly waiting for more information and news about Farmer's Dynasty 2.
Thank you for your patience. 
It has been worthwhile, since it doesn't get much bigger than this when it comes to news.

Because it is time for you to dust of your tools, get the tractors and harvesters in tip top condition and clear the stables, cowsheds and pigsties.

Why?

We have a release date!

Get ready to settle down in beautiful and cozy Green Thorn Valley, renovate your ancestor's run-down farm, take care of your crops and animals, help your neighbors and maybe even find the love of your life, so you can leave a long-lasting legacy for your offspring on December 5th, 2024, when Farmer's Dynasty 2 will be released in Early Access.

We cannot wait to welcome you to an agricultural adventure of a lifetime (or two)!

Umeo Studio and Toplitz Productions
